band_repair_note: 'warning' was driven from 40.0 to 22.752 by eleven consecutive x0.95 false-alarm nudges in learning_updater._maybe_adapt_state_thresholds, which only ever moved this boundary. Because Critical spans [critical, warning), that collapsed it to 2.75 points against Warning's 37.25, and engines skipped Warning -> Failure Risk directly (293 Critical rows vs 591 Failure Risk). Reset to critical + MIN_CRITICAL_BAND = 30.0, which keeps the feedback-driven lowering from 40.0 but restores a meaningful 10-point Critical band (1224 rows). The nudge rule now floors at this width so it cannot recur.
